sources.origin: fictional comments authored for evaluation on 2026-11-01; not customer data and contains no personal information
sources.design: 80 rows per language (30 positive, 25 neutral, 25 negative by draft label); 97 rows tagged mixed, negation, sarcasm, misspelling or rating_conflict
sources.label_provenance: AI-drafted labels (suggested.csv, written by the same AI assistant that authored the comments) used as final labels on 2026-11-01 because no human labellers were available; not independently human-labelled or verified, no inter-annotator agreement (kappa) measured; adjudication.csv marks every row source=ai-draft; labels-a.csv and labels-b.csv were left blank
sources.permitted_use: locked evaluation only; never used for training or tuning rules or models
sources.evaluation: provisional, 2026-11-01: rules macro-F1 0.839, local 0.827 (gate failed), xlmr 0.694 (gate failed); see docs/SENTIMENT_ANALYSIS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md

policy: Do not export or train on customer text until it has been redacted and independently reviewed.

models.license: not declared on the model card as of 2026-10-30; confirm with the authors before production use
models.training_data: multilingual tweets (Barbieri et al., XLM-T); Tagalog is not one of its fine-tuning languages
models.usage: inference only through SENTIMENT_XLMR_URL; no Casa Paraiso text is used for training
